tool_args.rationale: The pilot and long-horizon observations support adaptation, but a five-parameter sink-coupled mechanism remains confounded by covariation among horizon, input, and gradient. A fine trajectory can distinguish competing dynamics before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a sink-adjusted dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The eight observations show horizon reversal, but they do not uniquely identify how the sink gradient couples to the fast and slow dynamics.
Already acquired; its long-horizon rows establish reversal but leave the coupling mechanism ambiguous.
Its nuisance reading would not resolve the mechanism.
